watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「模封材料與翹曲控制」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Molding compounds and warpage control. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「材料組成」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Material composition requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「層合不對稱」列為查證任務：比較上下對稱及偏置晶粒截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Laminate asymmetry: Compare symmetric and offset-die sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：模封收縮、材料非線性與翹曲。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Mold shrinkage, material nonlinearity and warpage. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 底部填膠流動控制
related.why: 共用填料、Tg 和固化應力推理
related.whyEn: Shares filler, Tg and cure-stress reasoning
related.transfer: 共用填料、Tg 和固化應力推理
related.transferEn: Shares filler, Tg and cure-stress reasoning
related.difference: 模封厚區與底膠微間隙的流動尺度不同
related.differenceEn: Bulk mold regions differ from underfill microgaps
practice: 以「材料組成」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「樹脂、填料及界面決定流動與熱機性質。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「將材料批次連到實測曲線。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use material composition to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Resin, fillers and interfaces determine flow and thermomechanics.
Using "Link material lots to measured curves.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 扇出型面板級封裝
related.why: 大面積面板放大翹曲和材料不均效應
related.whyEn: Large panels magnify warp and material nonuniformity
related.transfer: 大面積面板放大翹曲和材料不均效應
related.transferEn: Large panels magnify warp and material nonuniformity
related.difference: 面板形狀和夾持條件不能直接沿用晶圓
related.differenceEn: Panel geometry/supports cannot simply copy wafer conditions
practice: 以「固化收縮」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「化學收縮與熱收縮可作用於不同時間段。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「分離等溫固化與降溫變形。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use cure shrinkage to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Chemical and thermal shrinkage occur over different intervals.
Using "Separate isothermal-cure and cooling deformation.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

history.textEn: Jason Chang and Richard Chang established ASE, whose first factory began operations in Kaohsiung.

history.title: 擴展半導體測試業務

history.title: 覆晶封裝進入量產
